data.content: Implemented on branch knots-88d1-enforcement-test-drift @ 8edfbeff8 (pushed). CORRECTED diagnosis: NOT uniformly v3->cli path drift. (2) 2 compiled-path tests used pre-promotion v3/@hive-flow/cli/dist paths — retargeted to cli/dist/src/{permission-guard,mcp-tools}. tests/enforcement.test.mjs now 119/119 (was 113/119); enforcement-security-property.test.ts 87/87.
